# A bill with `auto_apply_credit: true` and no `posted:` block.
#
# The vendor's credit settles what a posted bill put on the payable. This bill
# is not posted, so there is nothing on the payable for a credit to settle.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the bill.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_owners_credit_is_refused_for_an_unposted_record.py.
vendor "V001"
	name: "Supplier"
	currency: CAD

bill "BILL-UNPOSTED-CREDIT"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Paper"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
